key_insight: Stepwise reduction of target voltage bias enables successive self-limiting electrospray layers within the process’s overall thickness envelope.
engineering_relevance: Bias-controlled multilayer coating could simplify fabrication on complex, non-planar surfaces compared with multistep spin-coating and liftoff.
method: Apply a secondary voltage bias to the spray target to reduce coating thickness and improve uniformity.
Decrease the target bias stepwise to permit additional self-limiting deposition.
Demonstrate tri-layer polystyrene stacks and uniform tri-layer coatings on a complex geometry.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports bias-controlled tri-layer stacks and complex-geometry coatings, but provides no quantitative thickness, uniformity, or device-performance results.
watch_item: Functional devices require suitable SLED-compatible inks, and multilayer thickness remains constrained by the self-limiting deposition envelope.
paper_title: MULTI-LAYER SELF-LIMITING ELECTROSPRAY DEPOSITION USING VOLTAGE BIAS
